meaning: reports/release.json production_status and release_ready only say the route passed Synth's router and DRC gates. They are not review sign-off.

routing_and_drc.evidence: DRC: 0 unconnected pads, 0 errors on kicad-cli pcb drc. 2 nets manually escaped via resin-filled via-in-pad (jlc-filled-via profile).

erc_dispositioned.evidence: 17 ERC warnings (name convention, supply identity, ESD protection, decoupling separation). All non-blocking. See reports/ble_node.erc.json.

rf_review.evidence: 50 ohm feed: 0.145mm trace width computed from 4-layer stackup (microstrip, 0.1mm FR4, er=4.3). Exported as RF50 net class. Antenna keepout 8mm. Matching network values (3.9nH/1.0pF) per Nordic reference design. No independent RF expert review.

usb_si_review.evidence: USB 2.0 Full Speed. ESD protection on separate D+/D- channels. No controlled impedance on USB pair.

fabrication_review.evidence: via-in-pad at U1 (aQFN-73) requires resin-filled vias (jlc-filled-via manufacturer). JLCPCB confirmation pending.

component_review.evidence: BME280 substituted for BME680 (BME280 not in registry; BME680 is superset with gas sensing). Balun footprint corrected to real KiCad part. All parts need independent review.

bme280_requirement.evidence: Issue #365 specifies BME280. Registry had no BME280 part; authored bme280 synth.toml with same pinout as BME680 minus gas sensing. Used bme280 in design.
